reference: average over the 57 scalp channels common to both systems (NeuroScan days 1-2: CPz, P1, P2, I1, I2 dropped; Neuracle day 3: AF7, AF8 dropped), minus the session's bad channels (info['bads']); EOG/ECG excluded. Recorded reference: unknown (days 1-2), CPz inferred (day 3)
regressor: story audio (gapless mp3 decode; envelope / half-wave rectified)

backward.method: LOTO ridge backward decoder within each session (day), 57 common ch - bads, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz, avg ref; nulls: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and every other story of the session per held-out trial (subject null: 2000 draws of one null value per trial; population: mean of the subject nulls); lag sweep +-1 s in 1-sample (15.6 ms) steps, positive = stimulus delayed, parabolic peak, subject-bootstrap CI. Groups pooling sessions pool held-out trials of the per-session decoders

latency_trf_fc.method: forward TRF of the envelope per subject-session, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, FC mean (Fz Cz F3 F4 C3 C4, bads dropped), avg ref (57 common ch - bads); 'herrmann' windows P1 = max 20-90 ms, N1 = min 70-200 ms (same code as herrmann2025/momenian2024); 'wide' windows P1 20-160 ms, N1 70-280 ms

descriptive.note: descriptive only (TRF shape, not a pass criterion): the pkueeg2025 FC TRFs have no clear P1/N1; the P1/N1 picks in the herrmann windows land on shoulders/window edges. shift_vs_X = delay of this session's grand TRF relative to X maximising the correlation over 0-400 ms
